name: Saturday Night Blood Bath — 14 November 1998
no_appearances_reason: A real recall gap, not a negative — same essay-format recap issue as iwf-christmas-clash-1998, zero structural markers.

matches.note: Brawl for All contest (the recap: “Brawl for Matches”), the first of the night: North American Champion Coma against Youngbloods leader Bob “Monkey” Charlie, back in the IWF after a lengthy lay-off. The recap's writer gave Coma the first round “despite what the scorecards said” (they had Charlie scoring two takedowns, which the writer did not see), and the second and third rounds were Coma's; Coma advanced.

Lightweight match: Youngblood member Superstar, on his third straight defeat, lost to the newcomer Wan Chung Hai, who was coming off two unsuccessful championship bouts. A 360 Tornado kick brought the pinfall for Hai.

Handicap match: Yoshihiro Tenzan, booed as a heel, against the Mexican Marauders. Rico Robriguez won it for the Marauders with a suave buster after Tenzan lasted 11 minutes; Damon Storm of Armageddon then ran in with a baseball bat and bloodied Tenzan's nose.

Brawl for All contest: two-time IWF World Champion Rob “The Legend” Williams against Archangel. Williams took the first round on the punch count and a couple of takedowns and the second (two takedowns, Archangel scoring nothing); Archangel salvaged the third with a takedown and the punch count. Williams advanced and faces Tommy Gunn in the next round.

Brawl for All contest (scored rounds): John Constantine, the former North American Champion, lost to the lightweight contender Tommy Gunn (no iwf/giwf/uwf record: named here, not filed in the participants), who took the first and third rounds; Constantine edged the second. The result left Gunn facing Rob Williams in the second round, and Constantine went on to win the four-way main event.

Intercontinental Championship match: champion Curt Raines against Cerberus. At the 16-minute mark Jazon Parzon, at ringside, threw the ringbell to Cerberus, who used it on Raines and won, becoming the new Intercontinental Champion. Raines promised Parzon a serious injury at Halloween Hell.

Four-way main event, the winner to get a shot at Coma at Halloween Hell: Akira, MaK, John Constantine and Spu. Spu was eliminated by the Senton Bomb, MaK, helped by the rest of Team X-treme distracting the referee, went out at the 24th minute when Constantine dumped him on the mat, and Constantine eliminated his team-mate and Warrior Clan leader Akira in under ten seconds. Constantine won, setting up Coma v. Constantine IV.

name: King of the Ring

evidence.note: The site's own PPV listing bills it "the first ever PPV for the IWF," with a match for the vacant Tag Team Titles, and lists it before In Your Computer and Halloween Hell '98 in its own ordering.
The card's own source file, linked by ppv.htm, was never crawled by the Wayback Machine at all — no CDX row of any status code survives for it, at any capture date.

evidence.source: archive drive: 1 - UWF/UWF v3/New Site/Museum/IWF Additions/1998.htm (the fed's own 1998 year-in-review)
evidence.note: Carries actual RESULTS from the card: Scott Maestol & partner defeated the Crash Team for the World Tag Team Championship at 'the King of the Ring Pay Per View in July' — the missing show's outcomes survive in the fed's own retrospective even though the card itself does not.

notes: One of the fed's four confirmed PPVs; the only one of the four with zero Wayback coverage of its own source file (Halloween Hell and Christmas Clash are held; In Your Computer is the other total gap, below).
